origins.section: A Sort by Value per Dollar Is Not the Best Fill
Each Test Checks What the Planners Asked, on Data Small Enough to Solve by Hand
Design Note: Read Only the Columns You Use

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-greedy: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-greedy: Greedy fails when the last good projects do not fit the money left and a different mix would have used it.
recorded.prompt:q-stub-test: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-stub-test: an empty plan respects any budget, so a test that checked only the budget would pass on the stub. A test that cannot fail on the old code tests nothing about the change.
recorded.prompt:q-columns: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-columns: The cost is that a column the planner should use but ignores goes unnoticed: in this version the must-do flag is in the export and nothing reads it.

recorded.rule: Q2 v2: a giveaway, read from the question's own text alone
recorded.prompt:q-greedy: Answer ONLY from this question's own text: its stem and its options. Use no knowledge of the subject at all; treat every term as a word you have never met. Pick an option only when the wording itself singles it out: it is longer or more specific than the others, it repeats words from the stem, the others carry absolute terms such as 'always' or 'never', the stem's grammar fits it alone, or it restates the stem. A cue decides only when it clearly singles out one option over every other; a weak cue, or one another option shares, decides nothing. Otherwise answer 'none'. Say which cue decided it, or that none did.
recorded.outcome:q-greedy: from the question's text alone, the reader picked none; the key is 'a'
recorded.because:q-greedy: no cue singles out one option

recorded.prompt:q-greedy:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-greedy:b: sort the projects by value per $k and take each one that still fits
recorded.prompt:q-greedy:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-greedy:c: model.maximize(mathopt.fast_sum(p.value * x[p.project_id] for p in request.projects)) (the model maximizes total value under the budget row; it does not sort by ratio)
recorded.prompt:q-greedy:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-greedy:d: At the real envelope the greedy fill happens to match the model, and at $15M it is $208k short.
